steps.action: Register on the official Karnataka scholarship portal (SSP) and complete your student profile.
Request caste certificate and income certificate from the local Nadakacheri/Tahsildar office immediately, as they can take weeks to issue.

Prepare and upload all required documents (caste certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar, 2nd year mark sheet, bank account with IFSC, passport photo) and submit applications for Post‑Matric Scholarship (post‑bc) and Vidyasiri Scholarship before the 2026‑10‑31 deadline.
Check the Department of Technical Education portal for the Post‑Matric Scholarship (post‑tech) eligibility rules and apply if you meet them before 2026‑10‑31.

Confirm with your college scholarship cell or the respective official portals whether you qualify for the Arya Vyshya (post‑arya) and Brahmin (post‑brahmin) community‑specific scholarships; if not eligible, skip them.

plan.summary: You have two confirmed scholarships with deadlines in two days, so register on the state portal, gather caste and income certificates now, and submit both applications today. Use the next few days to verify the technical‑education scholarship and rule out the community‑specific ones.
